units.source_text: 菅公流放播磨，在明石驿（须磨附近）一宿，驿长同情他的不幸。

en.t: When Sugawara no Michizane was exiled to Harima, he spent a night at the Akashi post station near Suma, and the station master felt sympathy for his misfortune.

units.source_text: 菅公赋诗赠驿长道：“驿长莫惊时变改，一荣一落是春秋。”

en.t: Sugawara no Michizane composed a poem and gave it to the station master, saying, "Station master, do not be startled by the changes of the times; rise and fall, glory and decline, are the way of the seasons."
This is recorded in volume two of The Great Mirror.
This is a direct copy of the Chinese poem, not a translation.
